Label: Experiment key
Notes: Experiment version used for assignment and analytics.

Label: Original variant
Notes: Original homepage, pricing, header and footer; demo redirects to Cal.com.

Label: Baselane variant
Notes: Baselane homepage, pricing, header and footer; demo renders Baselane demo component.

Label: Disabled mode
Notes: No experiment enrollment; Baselane homepage/pricing and shell are default. Demo redirects to Cal.com.

Label: Allocation mode
Notes: Server-side random 50/50 allocation on eligible first non-prefetch marketing request. A PostHog flag toggle alone does not change routing.

Label: Persistent assignment cookie
Notes: Signed HttpOnly host-only cookie; 90-day expiry.

Label: Signing secret
Notes: Server-only signing secret of at least 32 characters; missing secret during active routing fails to control without measurement. Secret value omitted.

Label: Request variant marker
Notes: Value is control or new.

Label: Request measurement marker
Notes: Value 1 enables eligible experiment measurement; otherwise 0.

Label: HTML variant marker
Notes: Body attribute is control or new; absent when no variant is assigned.

Label: PostHog grouping property
Notes: Value is control or new; use this to distinguish variants.

Label: PostHog version property
Notes: Value is marketing-experience-v1.

Label: Exposure event
Notes: Captured only after analytics consent and successful attribution handoff. Includes variant properties and page path.

Label: Attribution failure event
Notes: Indicates failed attribution handoff; failed handoff does not count as successful exposure.

Label: Preview selection
Notes: Development or Vercel preview only; QA assignment persists via cookie when active and is excluded from measurement. Production ignores preview query selection.

Label: Staff exclusion
Notes: Staff exclusion cookie forces control without exposure; bots are also excluded.

Label: Consent mirror cookie
Notes: Mirrors analytics consent for the innflow.ai domain.

Label: Signup attribution cookie
Notes: Signed HttpOnly cookie shared with app; contains anonymous PostHog ID, variant and exposure timestamp; expires after 7 days.

Label: Primary conversion
Notes: Unique exposed people creating an account within 7 days; login is not a primary conversion. App delivery was not verified by this inventory.

Label: Shared content model
Notes: Other destinations share content inside the assigned header/footer. Both headers consume shared menu definitions.

Label: Navigation consistency
Notes: When assigned, full-document navigation keeps page and shell on the same assignment and applies mode changes on next navigation.

Label: Production observation
Destination or identifier: Baselane navbar; no body experiment marker
Notes: Consistent with mode off; production environment setting and PostHog launch state were not directly verified.

Label: Legacy markers
Notes: Legacy URL prefixes and baselane_* click-event labels are not reliable split identifiers. Use control/new experiment property.
